versions.changelog:
- Initial release of TikTok and Reels Script Writer.
- Instantly generates ready-to-film scripts for TikTok and Instagram Reels in three proven formats: trending audio hook, story/narrative, and educational.
- Includes detailed on-screen text, spoken lines, pacing notes, captions, and hashtag blocks for each script.
- User can choose a format or generate all three versions for any topic, product, or story.
- Optimized for current best practices in short-form video: strong hooks, scroll-stopping text, and comment-driving questions.
- Designed for content creators seeking high-performing, platform-native scripts.
